 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    common = {v for v, _ in counts.most_common(2)}
    fill = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    special = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid)
               for c, value in enumerate(row) if value not in common]
    rows = sorted({r for r, _ in special})
    cols = sorted({c for _, c in special})
    out = [[fill for _ in range(max(0, len(cols)-1))]
           for _ in range(max(0, len(rows)-1))]
    for i in range(len(rows)-1):
        for j in range(len(cols)-1):
            v = grid[rows[i]][cols[j]]
            if (v not in common and
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j+1]] == v and
                grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j]] == v and
                grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j+1]] == v):
                out[i][j] = v
    return out
"

 "content": "from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    """Decode a rasterized lattice whose equal corner marks color cells."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    ranked = counts.most_common()
    fill = ranked[0][0]
    line = ranked[1][0]

    # The repeated lattice boundaries are dominated by the second-most
    # frequent color; junction marks may replace a few boundary pixels.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == line for v in grid[r]) > w / 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line for r in range(h)) > h / 2]
    if len(rows) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:
        return [[fill]]

    out = [[fill for _ in range(len(cols) - 1)] for _ in range(len(rows) - 1)]
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            r0, r1 = rows[i], rows[i + 1]
            c0, c1 = cols[j], cols[j + 1]
            color = grid[r0][c0]
            if color != line and all(grid[r][c] == color
                                     for r, c in ((r0, c1), (r1, c0), (r1, c1))):
                out[i][j] = color

    # Ignore blank lattice margins outside the region containing marked cells.
    top, bottom = 0, len(out)
    left, right = 0, len(out[0])
    while bottom - top > 1 and all(v == fill for v in out[top]):
        top += 1
    while bottom - top > 1 and all(v == fill for v in out[bottom - 1]):
        bottom -= 1
    while right - left > 1 and all(out[r][left] == fill for r in range(top, bottom)):
        left += 1
    while right - left > 1 and all(out[r][right - 1] == fill for r in range(top, bottom)):
        right -= 1
    return [row[left:right] for row in out[top:bottom]]
